rootCause: Admin quote editor permits 100% discounts or custom negative lines so sponsor_quotes.total_cents can be zero. The original setStatus('paid') verified only status='accepted'; event creation and event listing verified only 'paid' labels, not that any positive fee was recorded. This could create a zero-fee vendor event if the owner subsequently enabled it and scoring certification passed.
impact: Unaudited zero-dollar vendor booking could be treated as paid and pass status gating, undermining the required paid giveaway booking fee.
correction: Reject zero-dollar quotes from the admin paid transition; require a positive safe-integer booked total and a positive paid_at integer on create-event and live event status. Keep both game certification and owner activation as independent gates.

sourceChecks.method: Exact fetched source evaluated with JavaScript V8 test harness using mocked quote database/score certification
sourceChecks.notes: Positive paid quote passes when game certified; zero or negative quote, missing payment timestamp, unpaid metadata block; syntax and runner references pass.

openIndependentGate: Admin mark-paid still represents manual bookkeeping, not verified money movement; signed Stripe webhook or independently reconciled on-chain/provider settlement is required before public commercial bookings. This fix MUST NOT be represented as complete payment protection.
deploymentSafety: Change isolated on feature branch and draft PR only. Auto Deploy OFF. Do not merge/deploy to current production or new Trap Tech account without full Docker+HTTP+payment tests and owner approval.
